name: DeviceTemperature
description: FPGA die temperature from board ADC, not the image sensor temperature.

name: FanStartTemperature
description: Hardware hysteresis upper threshold. Must exceed FanStopTemperature.

name: FanStopTemperature
description: Hardware hysteresis lower threshold. Must be below FanStartTemperature.

name: FanDutyCycle
description: PWM duty when hardware thermal hysteresis enables the fan. No tachometer/RPM feedback is wired.

name: StatusLEDs
description: Logical active-high status bits: 0 heartbeat, 1 sensor ready, 2 GigE ready, 3 streaming blink on images with independent video reset (version 10 and later). Physical LEDs are active-low.

name: SensorInputClock
description: Configured 12MHz module XCLK assumption, supported by measured frame timing.

name: AcquisitionFrameRate
description: Sensor frame rate limit through vertical blanking only; clocks remain unchanged. Actual transmitted rate can be lower because of conversion or network bandwidth.

name: ExposureTime
description: Exposure in microseconds; Line period follows the active image mode. Stop acquisition and set ExposureAuto=Off to change.

name: BalanceWhiteAuto
description: Continuous AWB is available in ISP formats. RAW has no valid AWB statistics; entering RAW seeds manual unity gains. Legacy RAW presets load with AWB Off and their saved gains.

name: SensorIspControl0
description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

name: SensorIspControl1
description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

name: SensorIspControl3
description: Masked sensor ISP control. Reserved bits are preserved.

name: EffectEnableBits
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectHueCos
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectHueSin
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectU
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectV
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectYOffset
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectContrast
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectBrightness
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectSigns
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectManualSaturation
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectUvThreshold1
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: EffectUvThreshold2
description: Staged setting. Stop acquisition then execute EffectApply to commit all effect parameters.

name: GammaPointSelector
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: GammaPointValue
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: GammaControl
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: LensCorrectionSelector
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: LensCorrectionValue
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: LensCorrectionEnable
description: Staged table setting; execute the corresponding Apply command while stopped.

name: SensorVcmAvailable
description: Per-unit capability. Enable only for a module with a wired VCM actuator.

name: SensorRegisterSelector
description: Named register catalogue from Ov5640Registers.h. Register values require stopped acquisition.

name: SensorFeatureApply
description: Stopped-only masked write to supported ISP/analog image-control ranges. Clock/reset/format/OTP/MCU registers are write-protected.

name: SensorOtpRefresh
description: Refresh the 32-byte OTP shadow. Read only; never programs OTP.

name: SensorJpegAvailable
description: JPEG transport is implemented in the matching CSI-byte production image; select VGA YUYV and ImageCompressionMode=JPEG.

name: SensorFrexAvailable
description: Unavailable until the corresponding board/transport integration is qualified.

name: SensorMcuFirmwareAvailable
description: Unavailable until the corresponding board/transport integration is qualified.

name: SensorOtpValid
description: The OTP read shadow becomes valid after SensorOtpRefresh succeeds.

name: ResultingFrameRate
description: Nominal sensor rate from current HTS/VTS, not network delivery FPS.

name: AutoExposureTarget
description: Average-luminance target in sensor units; updates stable and fast AEC thresholds.

name: SensorSharpness
description: Manual CIP strength in sensor register units. Has no effect on RAW output.

name: SensorDenoise
description: Manual CIP strength in sensor register units. Has no effect on RAW output.

name: SensorSharpnessAuto
description: Selects automatic CIP threshold; manual strength takes effect when Off.

name: SensorDenoiseAuto
description: Selects automatic CIP threshold; manual strength takes effect when Off.

name: SensorAverageLuminance
description: Sensor AEC weighted luminance readout; refreshed with live telemetry.

name: UserSetSave
description: Save UserSet1..7. Default is read-only through this standard command; factory provisioning uses the password-protected FactoryUserSetSave command.

name: ImageCompressionMode
description: JPEG requires VGA YUYV. Select 640x480 YUV422_YUYVPacked first. GVSP payload type JPEG; PayloadSize is maximum allocation, each leader carries actual encoded length.

name: SensorJpegQuality
description: OV5640 quantization scale, smaller values give higher quality/larger encoded frames.

name: DeviceConfigurationPending
description: Network/identity changes are journaled automatically while stopped. IP mode and identity apply on the next firmware boot.

name: DeviceReset
description: Asynchronously return to the power-up configuration: reset sensor/video and protocol, load UserSetDefault, and apply saved network/identity. Acquisition and ownership are released. Rediscover/reconnect after completion.

name: SensorTelemetryDeferred
description: Streaming defers SCCB telemetry above 105 MB/s or while software-converting images larger than 640x480 to avoid stranding sensor transactions during main-loop stalls. Cached values refresh during supported active acquisition or synchronous sensor operations; stopped background reads are disabled.

name: FactoryUserSetSave
description: Factory maintenance only: save the current profile into the factory slot. Requires UserSetSelector=Default and an unlocked factory password. Not part of standard UserSetSave.

name: FpgaProcessingCapabilities
description: Integrated PL capabilities: bit 0 black-level subtraction, bit 1 Bayer bad-pixel correction, bit 2 manual gains, bit 3 RGB demosaic, bit 4 RGB median, bit 5 ROI/area downscale, bit 6 CCM, bit 7 gamma, bit 8 FPGA AWB/statistics, bit 9 bilateral filtering, bit 10 sharpening, bit 11 RAW lens shading, bit 12 focus/motion analysis, bit 13 RGB-to-YUV output, bit 14 Xilinx polyphase resampling, bit 15 local contrast with shared RAW preprocessing, bit 16 adaptive RGB display tone mapping, bit 17 bounded integer-map remapping, bit 18 four-byte-per-clock framebuffer writer. Capability bits describe the installed FPGA image.

name: FpgaProcessingEnable
description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart while stopped. Processing supports BayerBG10/BayerBG10p and, when color capability is present, RGB8/BGR8. Other formats use byte bypass.

name: FpgaBadPixelCorrectionEnable
description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart while stopped. Processing supports BayerBG10/BayerBG10p and, when color capability is present, RGB8/BGR8. Other formats use byte bypass.

name: FpgaBlackLevel
description: 10-bit RAW black offset before BPC and gains. On audited v9/v10 active RAW processing, a live write applies to a subsequent complete HLS frame without restarting acquisition. Readback is the requested setting, not a frame-tagged applied value. Otherwise configure while stopped; applies at next AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaBalanceRed
description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaBalanceGreen
description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaBalanceBlue
description: Q8.8 Bayer gain, unity 1.0. Applied after BPC, saturated to 10 bits. Applies at next AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaProcessingActive
description: True during acquisition when a supported RAW10 or RGB processing path is selected.

name: FpgaMedianAvailable
description: Reports whether the installed FPGA image includes this RGB processing block.

name: FpgaScalerAvailable
description: Reports whether the installed FPGA image includes this RGB processing block.

name: FpgaMedianEnable
description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

name: FpgaScalerEnable
description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

name: FpgaRoiEnable
description: Applied at the next AcquisitionStart. Requires FPGA processing and RGB8/BGR8 or supported FPGA YUV output.

name: FpgaInputWidth
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaInputHeight
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaRoiOffsetX
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaRoiOffsetY
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaRoiWidth
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: FpgaRoiHeight
description: Input and ROI dimensions for FPGA color resampling. Width/Height select output size. ROI must fit the RAW input. Area mode only reduces; Polyphase permits up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis within the 2592x1944 output bounds. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Validated at AcquisitionStart.

name: SensorRawActive
description: The sensor uses its Bayer RAW tap, including FPGA RGB conversion. Sensor AWB and orientation are unavailable in this mode.

name: FpgaBalanceWhiteAuto
description: FPGA gray-world AWB: previous-frame admitted samples, gains 0.25x to 4x, quarter-step smoothing, green reference unity. Dark/saturated frames hold gains. Restart resets AWB to unity.

name: FpgaColorTransformationSelector
description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

name: FpgaColorOffsetSelector
description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

name: FpgaGammaChannel
description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

name: FpgaGammaIndex
description: Stopped-only table selector. Matrix order is RGB rows then RGB columns. Channel order is red, green, blue.

name: FpgaColorTransformationValue
description: Signed Q20 coefficient or DN offset in [-8,8). Applied before RGB8 conversion; vendor Q8 product intermediates and truncation apply.

name: FpgaColorOffsetValue
description: Signed Q20 coefficient or DN offset in [-8,8). Applied before RGB8 conversion; vendor Q8 product intermediates and truncation apply.

name: FpgaGammaValue
description: Selected channel/index RGB8 LUT value. Default is identity. All 768 LUT bytes persist in UserSet.

name: FpgaStatisticsLatch
description: Snapshot the latest complete FPGA frame statistics. Allowed during acquisition; read fields remain stable until the next latch.

name: FpgaStatisticsSequence
description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

name: FpgaStatisticsValidPixels
description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

name: FpgaClippedPixels
description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

name: FpgaDarkPixels
description: Latched complete-frame statistics. Sequence restarts at acquisition reset and is not the GVSP FrameID.

name: FpgaBalanceMeanRed
description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

name: FpgaBalanceMeanGreen
description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

name: FpgaBalanceMeanBlue
description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

name: FpgaIntensityMean
description: Latched Q16 mean. Color means precede gains/CCM and exclude samples with any channel below 8 or at least 1000 DN. Intensity is output RGB8 luma.

name: FpgaAppliedBalanceRed
description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

name: FpgaAppliedBalanceGreen
description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

name: FpgaAppliedBalanceBlue
description: Latched gains actually applied to the completed frame, independent of configured manual gains during AWB.

name: FpgaBilateralEnable
description: AMD 3x3 RGB bilateral filter after gamma/median and before ROI/scaling. Replicate border; disabled by default.

name: FpgaBilateralSigmaColor
description: RGB bilateral range sigma; default 24 DN.

name: FpgaBilateralSigmaSpace
description: RGB bilateral spatial sigma; Q8 value, default 1 pixel.

name: FpgaSharpenStrength
description: RGB cross-Laplacian strength [0,1] using AMD filter2D, saturated per channel. Zero bypasses. Constant-zero filter border can brighten image edges; assess halos and noise amplification.

name: FpgaLensShadingEnable
description: Programmable RAW10 lens shading after black/BPC and before demosaic or RAW manual gains. Four-phase 7x9 bilinear Q12 grid; default disabled with unity table. A real uniform-field calibration is required for optical correction.

name: FpgaLensShadingPhase
description: BGGR calibration plane; the two green CFA phases have independent tables.

name: FpgaLensShadingGain
description: Selected grid gain in [0,4], Q12 rounded interpolation and saturated RAW10 output. Default 1x. All 252 gains persist in UserSet; selectors do not.

name: FpgaSceneAnalysisEnable
description: Post-ROI RGB luma focus/motion diagnostics. Both output dimensions must be at least 32 for analysis; smaller images pass with zero/invalid metrics. First frame after acquisition restart has invalid motion. Illumination changes can trigger motion, and noise can increase focus.

name: FpgaFocusMean
description: Mean absolute four-neighbor luma Laplacian over the output interior, Q16 DN. Sensitive to ISP settings and noise. Latched with the common completed-frame statistics sequence.

name: FpgaMotionMean
description: Mean absolute difference of current/previous 32x32 luma-bin means, Q16 DN. First frame is invalid. Latched with the common completed-frame statistics sequence.

name: FpgaMotionValid
description: Latched valid preceding-frame comparison. False when analysis is disabled, dimensions are below 32, or history was reset.

name: FpgaYuvRange
description: BT.601 output levels for the FPGA RGB-to-YUV path. PixelFormat selects YUV444, four averaged-chroma YUV422 orders or legacy 2x2-chroma YUV420. Requires FPGA processing enabled and RAW10 sensor acquisition; native sensor YUV bypass retains its own timing and levels. RGB/BGR bypass is unchanged. Default Limited.

name: FpgaScalerInterpolation
description: Resample RGB/BGR or FPGA YUV using Area (default, downscale only) or six-tap, 64-phase Xilinx VPSS. Polyphase allows up to 4x enlargement per ROI axis, within 2592x1944 output and PixelFormat alignment limits. Larger downscale ratios use an area prefilter. Mixed up/down axes are supported. Equal geometry bypasses VPSS; an unchanged axis uses identity coefficients. Configure while stopped; output pixel rate and Ethernet payload can limit FPS.

name: FpgaLocalContrastEnable
description: Four-by-four-tile Xilinx CLAHE on RGB value, after optional scaling. Preserves RGB ratios with bounded fixed-point rounding; black remains black. Requires color FPGA processing, output dimensions at least 32, height multiple of 4 and width multiple of 8. Uses the preceding frame histogram; first frame after Start, geometry/clip change or reset bypasses. Can amplify noise or react to illumination changes. Default off; no optical calibration is implied.

name: FpgaLocalContrastClipLimit
description: Integer Xilinx CLAHE histogram clip multiplier, 1 through 8, default 4. Higher values allow stronger contrast/noise amplification. Configure while stopped.

name: FpgaBlackLevelLiveActive
description: True only while healthy audited v9/v10 FPGA RAW processing accepts frame-latched live Black Level writes. False during stop/drain/recovery, bypass and legacy processing. Other controls retain their existing locks.

name: FpgaUpscaleAvailable
description: Firmware supports bounded enlargement using the installed VPSS (processing v8 or later). Requires processing/scaler enabled and Polyphase selected. No additional FPGA resources; camera FPS acceptance is separate.

name: FpgaUpscaleMaximum
description: Maximum supported enlargement per ROI axis: 4 with VPSS, otherwise 1 (no enlargement). Output remains at most 2592x1944 and subject to PixelFormat alignment and link bandwidth. Area never enlarges.

name: FpgaAdaptiveToneAvailable
description: Matching v11 image includes the adaptive RGB display curve after CLAHE and before final scene statistics/output packing. This is not HDR radiance reconstruction.

name: FpgaAdaptiveToneEnable
description: Opt-in shared per-channel rational RGB8 curve driven by preceding input-frame weighted luma. Black/white endpoints fixed; gain 0.5x to 2x changes by at most 1/16 per frame. Can change color ratios and temporal brightness. First/start/reset/dimension/target-change frame bypasses. Configure while stopped. Default off; requires color FPGA processing.

name: FpgaAdaptiveToneTarget
description: Desired preceding-input weighted-luma mean, (R+2G+B)/4, default 128. Target is a bounded adaptation reference, not guaranteed output brightness. Configure while stopped; new acquisition resets history.

name: FpgaAdaptiveToneAppliedGain
description: Unlatched current HLS invocation gain; unity before first valid invocation. Not associated with a specific GVSP frame or common statistics latch.

name: FpgaAdaptiveTonePreviousMean
description: Unlatched preceding input-frame weighted-luma mean used by the current HLS invocation. First/reset invocation reports zero. Not frame-tagged; gain/mean reads are not an atomic pair.

name: FpgaDistortionAvailable
description: Matching image/control support for bounded640x480 nearest correction, +/-7 source rows. Does not imply calibrated lens parameters.

name: FpgaDistortionEnable
description: Volatile correction enable. Requires a completely validated map matching current color geometry. Default off; full-resolution bypass remains supported. Not saved in UserSet.

name: FpgaDistortionMapWidth
description: Staged map dimension. Set only after Abort, before Begin, with correction disabled. Must match output geometry; no implicit scaling.

name: FpgaDistortionMapHeight
description: Staged map dimension. Set only after Abort, before Begin, with correction disabled. Must match output geometry; no implicit scaling.

name: FpgaDistortionExpectedCrc32
description: CRC32 of raster little-endian32-bit map words, polynomial0xedb88320, standard initial/final XOR. Set before Begin; integrity check is not optical calibration.

name: FpgaDistortionMapBegin
description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

name: FpgaDistortionMapCommit
description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

name: FpgaDistortionMapAbort
description: Volatile map transfer command. Begin selects a staging bank; Commit starts bounded asynchronous validation; Abort invalidates staging without releasing a bank the reader may still access. Configure while stopped and disabled.

name: FpgaDistortionMapIndex
description: Raster map word index. Upload sequentially; explicit index/value pairs make identical retries idempotent.

name: FpgaDistortionMapData
description: Map word: valid bit31, source x bits9:0, source y bits18:10, reserved bits30:19 zero. Zero means black. Coordinates must be in bounds and within seven source rows; unsupported entries fail validation.

name: FpgaDistortionHardwareStatus
description: Last observed reader status: bit0 geometry, bit1 map encoding/window, bit2 input framing. Zero alone does not prove successful acquisition.

name: MaxAIEnabledFeatures
description: Volatile bitmask: face detection, face recognition, objects, plate candidates/OCR, motion, person HOG, QR, tracking. Unsupported bits are rejected. Defaults off. Results use the captured output image coordinates; no accuracy or real-time guarantee.

name: MaxAIMinimumScore
description: Score threshold in millionths. Model confidence is not calibrated probability.

name: MaxAIFaceCosineThreshold
description: Cosine similarity threshold in millionths; default0.45 is a starting point requiring validation on your enrollment data.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord0
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord1
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord2
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord3
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord4
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord5
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord6
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIObjectTextWord7
description: Four UTF-8 bytes packed least-significant-byte first. Eight words form a NUL-terminated32-byte label. Applies to identity, OCR or QR; labels may be truncated.

name: MaxAIResultWidth
description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

name: MaxAIResultHeight
description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

name: MaxAIResultPixelFormat
description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

name: MaxAIResultConfigGeneration
description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.

name: MaxAIResultAgeUs
description: Latched source geometry/configuration, or live elapsed microseconds since that capture was offered. Age saturates at32-bit maximum and is not wall-clock time.
